phone.notes: Storage no longer has Send to watch (the watch only takes Digimon of the farm: send them from the Farm tab). A stored copy marked as on the watch can be taken back with It is not on the watch. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Less battery use: steps are handed over one by one only while the screen is on. A Digimon that did not come from the farm can be removed from the watch (Transfer, REMOVE FROM WATCH).
